+name: Bench Retitle
+type: module
+description: 'Logs node title changes to the bench_retitle.log state key.'
+core_version_requirement: ^10 || ^11
+package: Custom
+dependencies:
+  - drupal:node
diff --git a/web/modules/custom/bench_retitle/src/Hook/BenchRetitleHooks.php b/web/modules/custom/bench_retitle/src/Hook/BenchRetitleHooks.php
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..79d9ae1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web/modules/custom/bench_retitle/src/Hook/BenchRetitleHooks.php
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_retitle\Hook;
+
+use Drupal\Core\Hook\Attribute\Hook;
+use Drupal\Core\State\StateInterface;
+use Drupal\node\NodeInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Hook implementations for bench_retitle.
+ */
+class BenchRetitleHooks {
+
+  /**
+   * Constructs a BenchRetitleHooks object.
+   */
+  public function __construct(
+    protected StateInterface $state,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Implements hook_node_update().
+   *
+   * Appends "<old title> -> <new title>" to bench_retitle.log when the title
+   * of an existing node changes.
+   */
+  #[Hook('node_update')]
+  public function nodeUpdate(NodeInterface $node): void {
+    $original = $node->getOriginal();
+    if ($original === NULL || $original->getTitle() === $node->getTitle()) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    $log = $this->state->get('bench_retitle.log', []);
+    $log[] = $original->getTitle() . ' -> ' . $node->getTitle();
+    $this->state->set('bench_retitle.log', $log);
+  }
+
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+<?php
+
+declare(strict_types=1);
+
+namespace Drupal\bench_summary;
+
+use Drupal\text\TextSummary;
+
+/**
+ * Generates teaser summaries of HTML using the text module's algorithm.
+ */
+class TeaserSummary {
+
+  public function __construct(
+    protected readonly TextSummary $textSummary,
+  ) {}
+
+  /**
+   * Summarizes HTML to the given size, cutting at paragraph or sentence ends.
+   *
+   * No text format is used, so no format-specific filters are applied.
+   *
+   * @param string $html
+   *   The HTML to summarize.
+   * @param int $size
+   *   The desired character length of the summary.
+   *
+   * @return string
+   *   The generated summary.
+   */
+  public function summarize(string $html, int $size): string {
+    return (string) $this->textSummary->generate($html, NULL, $size);
+  }
+
+}
